timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Cloud architecture patterns. Is that a real thing?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Very real. Retry, circuit breaker, cache-aside, queue-based load leveling. Proven building blocks.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's the big security concern for SaaS?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Tenant isolation. One customer reaching another's data is the nightmare scenario.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Per-tenant infrastructure, pool-per-tier, or shared services with row-level security.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Compute, network, storage, and data. Each layer needs its own boundary.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Per-tenant buckets or per-tenant encryption keys. Shared storage needs strict access controls.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Per-tenant databases or schemas, plus row-level security as defense in depth.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do I know isolation actually holds?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Test it. Pentest cross-tenant access like you'd test any security boundary.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So cheap shared infrastructure needs expensive testing?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The testing is what makes sharing safe. Skip it and sharing becomes a breach.
